title: Attach-Point Schema for Twin Layering
description: Defines how base pieces (furniture) expose slots that decor/lighting/textile items snap into, composing shoppable vignettes.

slot_id.description: Unique slot identifier within the base piece (e.g. 'seat_cushion_left', 'tabletop_center')

slot_type.description: How the attach-item relates to the slot physically

position.description: Position relative to base piece origin (floor_center), in meters

normal.description: Surface normal at the slot (for orientation of attached item)

accepts.description: Category IDs or attach_role values this slot accepts (e.g. ['FFE.TEXTILES.CUSHION', 'FFE.TEXTILES.THROW'])

max_items.description: How many items can stack/layer in this slot

size_constraint_mm.description: Max dimensions of items that fit this slot

attach_role.description: The role a decor/lighting item plays when attached to a base

base_type.description: What kind of base piece this is

slots.description: Attach points exposed by this base piece
